findings_promoted_to_tests: Wheel delta is normalized to direction so one hardware notch always means exactly three rows.
Thumb position uses normalized available travel and clamps to exact offset endpoints.
A transfer snapshots both collection versions before validation and commits or rejects both sides together.
A changed search query resets the scroll offset to the first row before rendering filtered results.
Transfer uses ModifierDoubleActivate so Inventory's frozen ModifierActivate multi-selection remains unchanged.
